description: Fetch accessibility issues from one source: scanId+scanRunId, buildId, workflowReportId, appReportId or reportUrl. Ids: a link, startAccessibilityScan, or web_accessibility lists (searchCapability).

appReportId.description: Manual App Accessibility report id (a UUID), from its /report/ link or a report listed via searchCapability.

buildId.description: Web or App Accessibility build id: the SDK's testhub id, a link's thBuildId, or one listed via searchCapability.

compareWith.description: "previous", or an older scanRunId of the same scan, or an earlier app build's id or link; lists new and resolved issues.

cursor.description: Character offset for pagination (default: 0); with compareWith, how many issues are already listed.

exportTaskId.description: Continue a CSV export that an earlier call said is still being generated.

pageUrl.description: Only the issues on this page URL, counted as the dashboard's page view counts them.

reportUrl.description: A web or app report dashboard link (scan, build, manual report), a scanner share link, or an (App) Automate link.

scanId.description: Website Scanner scan id: from startAccessibilityScan or list_website_scanner_scans (searchCapability).

scanRunId.description: Website Scanner run id: from startAccessibilityScan, or list_website_scanner_scan_runs (searchCapability).

workflowReportId.description: Workflow Analyzer report id: from its link, or list_workflow_analyzer_reports (searchCapability).

name: fetchAccessibilityIssues
